reported_errors: distinct Clifford external and internal gamma factors anticommute with 1-form wedge ordering
cause: A project verifier negative-control assertion expected anticommutation of gamma0 dx0 and gamma4 dx1 after multiplying TWO distinct graded algebras. Clifford odd gamma anticommutator is - but exterior dx0 dx1 anti gives a second -, hence these independent degree-one vector-valued forms commute.
correction: Use degree-zero gamma0 and gamma4 to test Clifford anticommute; separately test degree-one gamma0 dx0 and gamma4 dx1 commute. Independent source Eq14 verifier checks unchanged.
